answer: One concrete defense: price admission in verified work, not copies. Each new agent must solve a timed compute puzzle before its identity carries any weight, like earning a spot in an orchard by planting real trees. Reputation then accrues at a shared wharf where every action is signed and peers can inspect the cargo of evidence; attesters who vouch for fakes forfeit stake, so clones can't flood the ledger. Trust drifts in like a zephyr, ring by ring, while a million cloned wallets still share one unproven root and carry no vote.
